Role: UI/UX Designer Date: July 2022 Tools: Figma
Context
The current LoopOS Submission platform is difficult to use on mobile, leading to frustration and drop-offs, especially when filling out forms. Improving mobile usability is essential to enhance the overall user experience.
Wireframes


After analysing the requirements and conducting research, the following features and pages were identified:


Login
OAuth providers for social logins to ensure a quick and effortless authentication flow.


Recognition of product by voice
Voice recognition technology enables users to identify products hands-free, allowing for the simulation of the item's value before redirecting them to the form, reducing friction in the interaction.


Impact page
A dashboard that would showcase the real-time sustainability impact of the user's actions, encouraging more environmentally conscious decisions. This is one of the platform's most significant value propositions.


Wallet page
A wallet page to manage transaction tracking and display credit movements for users.


Resell, Renting and Returns
AI-optimized forms and item pages for Resell, Renting, and Returns to enhance user experience by streamlining data entry, personalizing interactions, and providing dynamic, context-driven information tailored to each transaction.


Chat
A chat enables real-time communication between clients and store operators, enhancing customer support.


"Member get member" and Hot deals
These features encourage user engagement and drive referrals, while offering exclusive promotions to enhance customer retention and satisfaction.



Styleguide





High-Fidelity Mockups

Form - Item Form - Seller Form - Delivery Form - Payment Item page
Simplified form layout
The form was restructured into easily digestible sections with clear labels and step-by-step navigation to reduce cognitive load and eliminate confusion.

Mobile-friendly UI
Elements were resized and repositioned to ensure a seamless user experience on smaller screens, with larger touch targets and responsive design to prevent frustration during input.

AI Integration for Product Assessment
Some AI-powered features like recognition by voice and image were added that provided real-time product suggestions and assessments, based on user input. This personalized assistance helped users fill forms more efficiently.
